title: FRT Runner Lease
description: Lease a runner holds over a claimed FRT run. Distinct from runner-job-lease.schema.json, which covers the generic ELMOS job model and carries no FRT run identity. A lease grants no rights by itself: it only bounds how long the control plane waits before treating a RUNNING run as abandoned. Losing a lease can never turn into success.

tenantId.description: Organization plus tenant is the isolation boundary of the run store; a lease never spans two tenants.

claimedVersion.description: Run version observed at claim time. The completion must present this version or it is rejected as a version conflict.

expiresAt.description: Absolute deadline. After this instant the control plane may apply onExpiry without consulting the runner.

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: How often the runner must renew. A renewal extends expiresAt only; it never changes claimedVersion or the run state.

onExpiry.description: BLOCK moves the run to BLOCKED with a typed finding and requires an operator retry. REQUEUE returns it to QUEUED for another runner. Neither may produce SUCCEEDED, and neither may set customerCodeExecuted or productionOperationExecuted.

maximumRenewals.description: Optional cap on renewals so a stuck runner cannot hold a run indefinitely. Reaching the cap applies onExpiry.
